name: KNH: Campus Days
source:
Welcome to KNH High School, a prestigious academy where the most admired—and most mysterious—students gather.

Each of the seven boys carries something hidden behind their smile: some are burdened, some chase perfection, and some simply long for connection.

As your final year begins, you unexpectedly end up in the same class as Ken, one of the most popular boys in school.

From that moment on, your last year unfolds—filled with laughter, challenges, heartfelt decisions, and maybe… something more.

[From [url=https://punglonewolf.itch.io/knh-campus-days]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到KNH高中，这是一所享有盛誉的学院，这里聚集着最受尊敬、最神秘的学生。

七个男孩的笑容背后都隐藏着一些东西：有些人有负担，有些人追求完美，有些人只是渴望联系。

当你最后一年开始时，你出乎意料地和肯（学校里最受欢迎的男孩之一）在同一个班级。

从那一刻起，你的最后一年就展开了——充满欢笑、挑战、衷心的决定，也许……还有更多。

[来自[url=https://punglonewolf.itch.io/knh-campus-days]Itch.io[/url]]
